The check holds only go commands on ci.yaml run: lines to their packages. A go command a script starts (script_run: scripts/e2e/*.sh, docs/site/scripts/generate.ts, packages/envoy/scripts/e2e-local.sh, …) is checked only for its pinned text, by substring. A package appended there, or a new go command in a script, is not caught. check-ci-filters.sh's header says the table's RULES and static reads are kept by hand. A script's go commands live in that same hand-kept table, so this is the same boundary.
